# Creator Brand Profile

Public name: Creator Brand Profile

Mood: coach-centered, personal, polished, trust-led.

Structure:

- Background: subtle profile glow and warm gradient.
- Cards: story/profile cards.
- CTA: personal invitation CTA.
- Navbar: profile/brand-led nav.
- Sticky CTA: coach-signature CTA bar.
- Bonus: resources from coach ecosystem.
